1st Jul - 5th Jul | Convention Centre Foyer

Banaras Ghat In My Eyes An exhibition of paintings by Chinmoy Pandit.


 

1st Jul - 4th Jul | Visual Arts Gallery

Panorama 24 A group exhibition by Uma Bardhan, Shy Porwal, Anindita Kishore, Amit Kumar, Meghna Agarrwal, Punam Rai, Darshan Lal Sharma, Ruchi Sharma, Meena Wason, & Mahendra Rai.

अद्वय A group painting and sculpture exhibition by Anita Kumari, Ashish Bose, Devilal Patidar, Hina Bhatt, J.D.
